# onpager_notification_template (Resource)

Manage one global notification template override for an explicit notification type, delivery provider and language.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_notification_template" "example" {
  type              = "alert_direct"
  delivery_provider = "telegram"
  language          = "en"
  format            = "telegram_html"
  body              = "Alert: {{.Alert.Title | escape}}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) Exact UTF-8 template source, required without a default. At most 65,536 bytes; blank bodies, NUL characters, null and empty strings are rejected. Whitespace and newlines are preserved. The API validates syntax and allowed context fields when saving. Stored in Terraform state.
- `delivery_provider` (String) Immutable delivery provider, required without a default: `telegram`, `mattermost`, `slack`, `discord`, `pachca`, or `zvonok`. Zvonok supports only `alert_direct`, `incident_call`, `responder_request`, and `responder_feedback`; only `alert_direct` supports a team override. Null and empty strings are invalid. Changing it replaces this resource. No channel lookup or delivery occurs.
- `format` (String) Template format, required without a default. Telegram supports `telegram_html`, `telegram_markdown_v2`, or `plain`; Mattermost `mattermost_markdown`; Slack `slack_mrkdwn` or `slack_plain`; Discord `discord_markdown`; Pachca `pachca_markdown`; Zvonok `plain`. Must match `delivery_provider`; null and empty strings are invalid.
- `language` (String) Immutable template language, exactly `ru` or `en`, required without a default. Null and empty strings are invalid. Each language has independent overrides, inheritance and ETags; there is no fallback to the other language. Changing it replaces this resource.
- `type` (String) Immutable notification type, required without a default; null and empty strings are invalid. Supported values: `alert_direct`, `alert_channel`, `schedule_handover`, `incident_announcement`, `incident_call`, `responder_request`, `alert_channel_call`, `responder_feedback`, `connection_confirmation`. Changing it replaces this resource.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Strong SHA-256 ETag of this exact override slot, used as `If-Match` for replacement and deletion. Independent of inherited content; concurrent changes report a conflict.
- `id` (String) Stable global override slot identity: `type/provider/language`. Also used for import.

## Import

Import using `type/provider/language`, for example `alert_direct/telegram/en`.
Only a stored global override can be imported.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_notification_template.example
  id = "alert_direct/telegram/en"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_notification_template.example alert_direct/telegram/en
```

## Lifecycle

This resource owns one global template override slot. Type, delivery provider and
language are immutable; changing them replaces the resource. Create reads the
slot's current ETag before saving the override. Updates and destroy use the saved
strong SHA-256 ETag. Concurrent changes require a new plan; inherited
effective-template revisions are not used.

Destroy deletes the override and restores inheritance from the current built-in
template in the selected language. A successful direct read with `override: null`
confirms absence and removes state. Inherited effective content is not adopted
as an override. HTTP errors, including 404, and malformed responses retain state.
A confirmed successful save retains the slot identity even if its receipt is malformed,
allowing refresh to recover it.

Template source persists in Terraform state. Required `format` and `body` have
no defaults; null and empty values are invalid. Body whitespace and newlines are
preserved. Other override slots are managed separately. Each `ru` or `en` slot
inherits only from the same language; neither language falls back to the other.

The five bot delivery providers support the documented notification types.
`zvonok` supports only `alert_direct`, `incident_call`, `responder_request` and
`responder_feedback`, using `plain` format; only `alert_direct` permits a team
override. The API calls this identity component `provider`; Terraform uses
`delivery_provider` because `provider` is a reserved resource meta-argument.
Zvonok normalizes whitespace and limits rendered speech to 500 Unicode
characters (or the configured delivery limit). This does not shorten or normalize
the saved source, which retains the 65,536-byte source limit.

## Permissions

Requires tenant grants `notification_templates.read`,
`notification_templates.update` and `notification_templates.delete`, including
for service accounts. Preview and human-only self-test grants are not required.
